title: Louisville Cops Chasing a Pig
description:
* (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) *
Louisville, Kentucky — The Louisville Metro Police Department released bodycam footage of cops and residents attempting to catch the energetic pig, with some toppling over in the process. Despite attempts to leash it, the pig escaped until it was cornered in a backyard and caught with a dog pole. The pig, Mr. BaconBits, was securely returned to its owners with the assistance of a large dog crate. Laughter and good times erupted as the officers joked about being "a couple of pigs chasing a pig."
